2. addRRset with multiple records same name/type (e.g., AAAA two records). After adding, findRecords returns both.

4. addRRset with duplicate name/type should merge with existing? Not needed.

We need to ensure we don't call private methods.

We need helper methods similar to existing test: listOf, oneRRset.

Also need to handle possible IOException in constructors; wrap in try-catch and rethrow RuntimeException.
